Name: opulence catalogue
Author: flowersinrevolt
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
A continuously updated catalogue of home decor. It's based on excessive luxury.  This is my first catalogue mod, so I hope you like it.  
It's an expensive catalogue and can only be purchased at Sandy's. If you haven't unlocked the Desert Trader yet, you will need to buy it.

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Put the mod in the mods folder. It does have other mods you must download with it to make it work in game, however.[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Adds lots of decor to your game. Loosely inspired by Marie Antonniette.[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]DOWNLOAD THE REQUIRED MODS!![/color][/size]
